summary: Completed comprehensive testing of League Management Portal - Auth, Session Persistence, Team Navigation, and Finance features. All backend APIs (19/19 tests passed) and frontend features working correctly.

issues: Ticker animation at top causes element instability during automated testing - elements become unstable during animation. This is a known issue from previous testing.

Login flow properly validates credentials and returns user object with roles
Session restoration on page load works correctly (lines 70-79 in App.js)
Finance tab correctly appears only for team admins/coaches (isTeamCoachOrAdmin check in TeamDetailPage.js)
Export CSV button has proper data-testid='export-csv-btn' for testing
Add Transaction button has proper data-testid='add-transaction-btn' for testing
TeamDetailPage.js refactored from 1150 to 305 lines - all extracted components working correctly
